attributes.name: [Elastic Cloud] Password guessing
attributes.description: One identity fails to sign in at least 15 times in 10 minutes.

investigation_guide.blob:
## Password guessing

One identity produced at least 15 `authentication_failed` events in 10 minutes. `realm_authentication_failed` is not counted, so one attempt is one event.

### Triage
1. Open **[Audit] Identity & Access** and confirm the identity.
2. Check whether a later success came from the same identity.
3. Platform accounts such as `elastic/kibana` are already excluded.

### Tuning
Raise the 15-failure threshold in the query if a chatty client retries.

esqlQuery.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_failed"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name)
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL
| EVAL actor_kind = CASE(user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "cloud_api_key", user.email IS NOT NULL, "user", api_key.name IS NOT NULL OR authentication.type == "api_key", "api_key", "principal")
| WHERE actor NOT IN ("elastic.maintenance", "autoscaling", "elasticsearch-controller", "elastic/fleet-server", "elastic/kibana")
// One attempt is one authentication_failed. realm_authentication_failed is a per-realm echo and is left out.
| STATS failures = COUNT(*), source_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip) BY actor, actor_kind
| WHERE failures >= 15
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 100
